Through the window

Head first over the sill · onto the hands · roll along the wall · up on the next tile

Loading traversal study…

One square is one tile; the window is the game's own (sill 0.85, opening 0.70 tall). The character starts on the tile centre outside and must finish standing on the next tile's centre, facing on. Contacts come from the skinned surface, checked by phantom-wrench (docs/tactics/NATURAL-TRAVERSAL.md).
